name: task-tagging
description: Tag a planning task or ticket with area, effort, risk, and whether other work is blocked on it. State: the task title + description as plain text or {"title":..,"body":..}.

area.instructions: Which part of the system does this task concern?

criteria.data: database schema, migrations, data quality, reporting
criteria.other: none of the above, or spans multiple areas

effort.instructions: How much engineering effort does this task look like it needs (t-shirt size)?
criteria: XS: minutes to a couple hours, a trivial change
S: about a day, a small well-scoped change
M: a few days, moderate scope or some unknowns
L: one to two weeks, significant scope or a cross-cutting change
XL: multiple weeks, large or poorly-understood scope

risk.instructions: How risky is this task: chance of breaking something, needing rework, or hitting unknowns?
criteria: medium: touches shared code or has some unknowns
high: touches critical paths or data, or has significant unknowns

blocking.instructions: Does this task's description say or imply that other work is waiting on it?

criteria.true: other work is blocked on this
criteria.false: nothing described as waiting on this
